.²1 Final, last, concluding; {#vidaDe viDimasya nEzWikam#} <ls>R. 8. 25</ls>.
.²2 Decided, definitive, conclusive (as a reply.); {#ezA no nEzWikI budDiH#} <ls>Mb. 1. 37. 29</ls>.
.²3 Fixed, firm, constant; {#SAntimApnoti nEzWikIm#} <ls>Bg. 5. 12</ls>; {#BaktirBavati#}

 {#nAsya Darmam#} <ls>Bu. Ch. 1. 82</ls>.

.²5 Completely familiar with or versed in.

A perpetual religious student who continues with his spiritual precept
 or even after the prescribed period, and vows life-long abstinence and
 chastity; {#nivedito nEzWikasundarastayA#} <ls>Ku. 5. 62</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> {#nEzWiko brahmacArI#}
 {#tu vasedAcAryasaMniDO#} <ls>Y. 1. 49</ls> and {#upakurvARa#} also.
